description: Rank every currency in a Big Mac index release by how over- or under-valued it is against a base currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY or CNY), raw or GDP-adjusted, most overvalued first. Use for "which currencies are cheapest/most expensive by the Big Mac index". Source: The Economist big-mac-data (MIT).

adjusted.description: Rank by the GDP-adjusted valuation instead of raw (default false).

date.description: Index release: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD or "latest" (default).

name: big_mac_valuation
title: Big Mac Valuation
